title: Day Trip or Sunset Trip: Which Is Better With Children in Madeira?
description: For most children the Day Trip: swimming, jumping in and paddle boards, back by lunchtime. The Sunset Trip suits calmer, older kids, but it has no swimming.
heroAlt: A small child seen from behind holding an adult's hand on the pontoon beside a white boat
keywords: day trip or sunset trip with children Madeira
can kids swim on a boat trip Madeira
best boat trip for families Madeira
